settings.heading: The honest small print
settings.text: Tap a question.

settings.question: Is a pre-order guaranteed?
settings.answer: It is a reservation. Availability is final only when the lab confirms after the cut-off, so keep an eye on your email and phone.

settings.question: What if my plant is unavailable?
settings.answer: We contact you within about two business days of the cut-off. You choose a full refund, another plant of equal value, or pay the difference for a different one.

settings.question: Can I cancel a pre-order?
settings.answer: No. Once a batch closes the laboratory has been paid for your plant. Ready-to-ship orders can be cancelled any time before they ship.

settings.question: When does the next batch open?
settings.answer: Usually 15 to 30 days after a cut-off. Orders placed after a cut-off join the next batch automatically.

settings.question: What arrives?
settings.answer: A tissue-culture plantlet in the sealed container it left the lab in, with roots but no soil. The free starter kit and the Acclimation Guide take it from there.
